Hi Samantha / Paul —

Thanks again for hosting us this week. Attached are the two artifacts we promised at close: an exec summary and a consolidated action map. The goal here is to make it as easy as possible for your internal teams to take the outcomes forward and for us to track progress from Redwood's side.

Quick notes on the attachments:
- Harlan_Exec_Summary_v1.pdf: 1-page summary for your leadership; highlights outcomes, success metrics, and suggested milestones.
- Harlan_Workshop_Action_Map_v1.xlsx: tabbed by workstream (Integration, Security, Ops, Commercial). Column headers: Action, Owner, Redwood owner, Due, Status, Notes.

Please review the owners and due dates in the action map. Where we were unsure of an owner, I left Harlan as the placeholder so you can reassign internally. Proposed next steps:
1) Internal owner confirmation from Harlan by EOD Friday (Jul 17)
2) Redwood to publish a read-only tracker and a weekly status sync cadence (15 min) starting the week of Jul 20
3) Aditya to produce the initial support runbook and a target deployment plan (draft by Jul 24)

I've copied Aditya and Jonas: Aditya will own the infra deliverables, Jonas will coordinate the Can-Do list for exec asks (SLA, data isolation), and Stephanie will help with procurement/billing alignment if any credits or contracts need updates.

Attachments: Harlan_Workshop_Action_Map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB), Harlan_Exec_Summary_v1.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

Thanks — talk soon.
